items.source: Projection expressions are used to define the fields that are the outcome of a particular aggregation step. Projection expressions can be defined through the project method of the Aggregation class, either by passing a list of String objects or an aggregation framework Fields object. The projection can be extended with additional fields through a fluent API by using the and(String) method and aliased by using the as(String) method. Note that you can also define fields with aliases by using the Fields.field static factory method of the aggregation framework, which you can then use to construct a new Fields instance. References to projected fields in later aggregation stages are valid only for the field names of included fields or their aliases (including newly defined fields and their aliases). Fields not included in the projection cannot be referenced in later aggregation stages. The following listings show examples of projection expression:
items.translation: 投影表达式用于定义特定聚合步骤的输出字段。可以通过 Aggregation 类的 project 方法定义投影表达式，该方法接受一个 String 对象列表或聚合框架的 Fields 对象作为参数。还可以使用流式 API 中的 and(String) 方法添加更多字段，并使用 as(String) 方法为字段设置别名。 请注意，您也可以通过聚合框架中 Fields.field 静态工厂方法来定义带别名的字段，然后使用该对象构建一个新的 Fields 实例。后续聚合阶段中对投影字段的引用仅对已包含字段或其别名（包括新定义的字段及其别名）有效。未包含在投影中的字段无法在后续聚合阶段中被引用。以下示例展示了投影表达式的用法：

items.source: Bucket operations categorize incoming documents into groups, called buckets, based on a specified expression and bucket boundaries. Bucket operations require a grouping field or a grouping expression. You can define them by using the bucket() and bucketAuto() methods of the Aggregate class. BucketOperation and BucketAutoOperation can expose accumulations based on aggregation expressions for input documents. You can extend the bucket operation with additional parameters through a fluent API by using the with…() methods and the andOutput(String) method. You can alias the operation by using the as(String) method. Each bucket is represented as a document in the output.
items.translation: Bucket 操作根据指定的表达式和桶边界，将传入的文档分类到称为“桶”的组中。Bucket 操作需要一个分组字段或分组表达式。您可以使用 Aggregate 类的 bucket() 和 bucketAuto() 方法来定义它们。BucketOperation 和 BucketAutoOperation 可以基于输入文档的聚合表达式暴露累积结果。您可以通过使用 with…() 方法和 andOutput(String) 方法，通过流式 API 为 Bucket 操作添加额外参数。您可以使用 as(String) 方法为操作设置别名。每个桶在输出中均表示为一个文档。

items.source: This one-step aggregation uses a projection operation with the inventory collection. We project the discount field by using a conditional operation for all inventory items that have a qty greater than or equal to 250. A second conditional projection is performed for the description field. We apply the Unspecified description to all items that either do not have a description field or items that have a null description.
items.translation: 此一步聚合操作使用了对inventory集合的投影。我们利用条件操作，对所有库存项中qty大于或等于250的项目投影discount字段。随后，对description字段执行了第二次条件投影。我们将Unspecified描述应用于所有缺少description字段或该字段值为null的项目。

items.source: Use the group operation to define a group from the input-collection. The grouping criteria is the combination of the state and city fields, which forms the ID structure of the group. We aggregate the value of the population property from the grouped elements by using the sum operator and save the result in the pop field.
items.translation: 使用 `group` 操作从输入集合中定义分组。分组依据是 `state` 和 `city` 字段的组合，它们构成了分组的 ID 结构。我们使用 `sum` 操作符对分组元素的 `population` 属性值进行聚合，并将结果保存在 `pop` 字段中。

items.source: Use the sort operation to sort the intermediate-result by the pop, state and city fields, in ascending order, such that the smallest city is at the top and the biggest city is at the bottom of the result. Note that the sorting on state and city is implicitly performed against the group ID fields (which Spring Data MongoDB handled).
items.translation: 使用sort操作按pop、state和city字段对中间结果进行升序排序，使得城市最小的记录位于结果顶部，城市最大的记录位于底部。请注意，对state和city的排序是隐式针对组 ID 字段进行的（由 Spring Data MongoDB 处理）。

items.source: Use a group operation again to group the intermediate result by state. Note that state again implicitly references a group ID field. We select the name and the population count of the biggest and smallest city with calls to the last(…) and first(…​) operators, respectively, in the project operation.
items.translation: 再次使用group操作，根据state对中间结果进行分组。注意，state同样隐式引用了一个组 ID 字段。在project操作中，我们分别通过调用last(…)和first(…​)操作符，选择名称最大和最小的城市及其人口数量。

items.source: An Aggregation represents a MongoDB aggregate operation and holds the description of the aggregation pipeline instructions. Aggregations are created by invoking the appropriate newAggregation(…) static factory method of the Aggregation class, which takes a list of AggregateOperation and an optional input class.
items.translation: Aggregation 表示 MongoDB 的 aggregate 操作，并包含聚合管道指令的描述。聚合是通过调用 Aggregation 类的适当静态工厂方法 newAggregation(…) 创建的，该方法接受一个 AggregateOperation 列表和一个可选的输入类。

items.source: Select the state field from the previous group operation. Note that state again implicitly references a group ID field. Because we do not want an implicitly generated ID to appear, we exclude the ID from the previous operation by using and(previousOperation()).exclude(). Because we want to populate the nested City structures in our output class, we have to emit appropriate sub-documents by using the nested method.
items.translation: 从上一个group操作中选取state字段。请注意，state再次隐式引用了一个组 ID 字段。由于我们不希望出现隐式生成的 ID，因此通过使用and(previousOperation()).exclude()将 ID 从之前的操作中排除。因为我们要在输出类中填充嵌套的City结构，所以必须使用嵌套方法发出适当的子文档。

items.source: The Aggregation Framework support in Spring Data MongoDB is based on the following key abstractions: Aggregation and AggregationResults.
items.translation: Spring Data MongoDB 中的聚合框架支持基于以下关键抽象：Aggregation 和 AggregationResults。

items.source: An AggregationDefinition represents a MongoDB aggregation pipeline operation and describes the processing that should be performed in this aggregation step. Although you could manually create an AggregationDefinition, we recommend using the static factory methods provided by the Aggregate class to construct an AggregateOperation.
items.translation: AggregationDefinition 表示 MongoDB 聚合管道操作，并描述应在该聚合步骤中执行的处理。尽管您可以手动创建 AggregationDefinition，但我们建议使用 Aggregate 类提供的静态工厂方法来构建 AggregateOperation。

items.source: Unsupported aggregation stages (like $search for MongoDB Atlas) can be provided by implementing either AggregationOperation. Aggregation.stage is a shortcut for registering a pipeline stage by providing its JSON or Bson representation.
items.translation: 不支持的聚合阶段（例如 MongoDB Atlas 的$search）可以通过实现AggregationOperation来提供。 Aggregation.stage是用于通过提供其 JSON 或Bson表示形式来注册管道阶段的快捷方式。

items.source: To create output fields in buckets, bucket operations can use AggregationExpression through andOutput() and SpEL expressions through andOutputExpression().
items.translation: 要在桶中创建输出字段，桶操作可以通过AggregationExpression使用andOutput()，并通过andOutputExpression()使用SpEL 表达式。

items.source: Note that further details regarding bucket expressions can be found in the $bucket section and $bucketAuto section of the MongoDB Aggregation Framework reference documentation.
items.translation: 请注意，有关桶表达式的更多详细信息可以在 MongoDB 聚合框架参考文档的 $bucket 和 $bucketAuto 部分中找到。

items.source: You can define a FacetOperation by using the facet() method of the Aggregation class. You can customize it with multiple aggregation pipelines by using the and() method. Each sub-pipeline has its own field in the output document where its results are stored as an array of documents.
items.translation: 您可以使用 `Aggregation` 类的 `facet()` 方法来定义一个 `FacetOperation`。您可以通过 `and()` 方法使用多个聚合管道对其进行自定义。每个子管道在输出文档中都有自己的字段，其结果以文档数组的形式存储在该字段中。

items.source: Use the group operation to define a group for each tags value for which we aggregate the occurrence count (by using the count aggregation operator and collecting the result in a new field called n).
items.translation: 使用group操作为每个tags值定义一个组，并聚合其出现次数（通过使用count聚合算子并将结果收集到一个名为n的新字段中）。

items.source: BucketAutoOperation determines boundaries in an attempt to evenly distribute documents into a specified number of buckets. BucketAutoOperation optionally takes a granularity value that specifies the preferred number series to use to ensure that the calculated boundary edges end on preferred round numbers or on powers of 10. The following listing shows examples of bucket operations:
items.translation: `BucketAutoOperation` 通过确定边界，尝试将文档均匀分配到指定数量的桶中。`BucketAutoOperation` 可选地接受一个粒度值，该值用于指定要使用的优选数系列，以确保计算出的边界边缘落在优选的整数或 10 的幂上。以下示例展示了桶操作：

items.source: We support the use of SpEL expressions in projection expressions through the andExpression method of the ProjectionOperation and BucketOperation classes. This feature lets you define the desired expression as a SpEL expression. On running a query, the SpEL expression is translated into a corresponding MongoDB projection expression part. This arrangement makes it much easier to express complex calculations.
items.translation: 我们支持在 `ProjectionOperation` 和 `BucketOperation` 类的 `andExpression` 方法中使用 SpEL 表达式作为投影表达式。此功能允许您将所需的表达式定义为 SpEL 表达式。在执行查询时，SpEL 表达式会被转换为相应的 MongoDB 投影表达式部分。这种安排使得表达复杂的计算变得更加容易。

items.source: You can see examples in more context in Aggregation Framework Example 5 and Aggregation Framework Example 6. You can find more usage examples for supported SpEL expression constructs in SpelExpressionTransformerUnitTests.
items.translation: 您可以在聚合框架示例 5和聚合框架示例 6中查看更完整的上下文示例。 有关支持的 SpEL 表达式构造的更多使用示例，请参阅SpelExpressionTransformerUnitTests。

items.source: Select the n field and create an alias for the ID field generated from the previous group operation (hence the call to previousOperation()) with a name of tag.
items.translation: 选择 `n` 字段，并为上一个分组操作生成的 ID 字段创建一个名为 `tag` 的别名（因此需要调用 `previousOperation()`）。

items.source: Call the aggregate method on MongoTemplate to let MongoDB perform the actual aggregation operation, with the created Aggregation as an argument.
items.translation: 在 MongoTemplate 上调用 aggregate 方法，将创建的 Aggregation 作为参数传入，以让 MongoDB 执行实际的聚合操作。

items.source: Note that the input collection is explicitly specified as the tags parameter to the aggregate Method. If the name of the input collection is not specified explicitly, it is derived from the input class passed as the first parameter to the newAggreation method.
items.translation: 请注意，输入集合被显式指定为传递给 `aggregate` 方法的 `tags` 参数。如果未显式指定输入集合的名称，则它将从作为第一个参数传递给 `newAggreation` 方法的输入类中推导出来。

items.source: Group the input collection by the state field and calculate the sum of the population field and store the result in the new field "totalPop".
items.translation: 按 `state` 字段对输入集合进行分组，计算 `population` 字段的总和，并将结果存储在新字段 `"totalPop"` 中。

items.source: The actual aggregate operation is run by the aggregate method of the MongoTemplate, which takes the desired output class as a parameter.
items.translation: 实际的聚合操作由 `MongoTemplate` 的 `aggregate` 方法执行，该方法将期望的输出类作为参数传入。

items.source: A TypedAggregation, just like an Aggregation, holds the instructions of the aggregation pipeline and a reference to the input type, that is used for mapping domain properties to actual document fields.
items.translation: `TypedAggregation` 与 `Aggregation` 类似，既包含聚合管道的指令，又包含对输入类型的引用，该类型用于将领域属性映射到实际的文档字段。

items.source: Changed in 3.2 referencing non-existent properties does no longer raise errors. To restore the previous behaviour use the strictMapping option of AggregationOptions.
items.translation: 在 3.2 版本中，引用不存在的属性不再抛出错误。若要恢复之前的行为，请使用AggregationOptions的strictMapping选项。

items.source: AggregationResults is the container for the result of an aggregate operation. It provides access to the raw aggregation result, in the form of a Document to the mapped objects and other information about the aggregation.
items.translation: `AggregationResults` 是聚合操作结果的容器。它提供对原始聚合结果（以 `Document` 形式）的访问，以及关于聚合的映射对象和其他信息。

items.source: Note that, if you provide an input class as the first parameter to the newAggregation method, the MongoTemplate derives the name of the input collection from this class. Otherwise, if you do not not specify an input class, you must provide the name of the input collection explicitly. If both an input class and an input collection are provided, the latter takes precedence.
items.translation: 请注意，如果您将输入类作为第一个参数传递给 newAggregation 方法，MongoTemplate 将从该类中推导输入集合的名称。否则，如果您未指定输入类，则必须显式提供输入集合的名称。如果同时提供了输入类和输入集合，以后者为准。

items.source: More examples for project operations can be found in the AggregationTests class. Note that further details regarding the projection expressions can be found in the corresponding section of the MongoDB Aggregation Framework reference documentation.
items.translation: 有关项目操作的更多示例，请参阅AggregationTests类。请注意，关于投影表达式的进一步详细信息，可参考MongoDB聚合框架参考文档中的相应部分。

items.source: Note that further details regarding facet operation can be found in the $facet section of the MongoDB Aggregation Framework reference documentation.
items.translation: 请注意，有关 facet 操作的更多详细信息可以在 MongoDB 聚合框架参考文档的$facet部分中找到。

items.source: Create a new aggregation by using the newAggregation static factory method, to which we pass a list of aggregation operations. These aggregate operations define the aggregation pipeline of our Aggregation.
items.translation: 使用 `newAggregation` 静态工厂方法创建一个新的聚合，并传入一个聚合操作列表。这些聚合操作定义了我们的 `Aggregation` 的聚合管道。

items.source: Use the project operation to select the tags field (which is an array of strings) from the input collection.
items.translation: 使用 `project` 操作从输入集合中选取 `tags` 字段（该字段为字符串数组）。

items.source: Use the unwind operation to generate a new document for each tag within the tags array.
items.translation: 使用unwind操作为tags数组中的每个标签生成一个新文档。

items.source: Note that the ZipInfo class maps the structure of the given input-collection. The ZipInfoStats class defines the structure in the desired output format.
items.translation: 请注意，ZipInfo 类映射给定输入集合的结构。ZipInfoStats 类定义所需输出格式的结构。

items.source: Sort the resulting list of StateStats by their state name in ascending order in the sort operation.
items.translation: 在 `sort` 操作中，按州名升序对生成的 `StateStats` 列表进行排序。

items.source: Note that we derive the name of the input collection from the ZipInfo class passed as the first parameter to the newAggregation method.
items.translation: 请注意，输入集合的名称是从作为newAggregation方法第一个参数传递的ZipInfo类中派生的。

items.source: Filter the intermediate result by using a match operation which accepts a Criteria query as an argument.
items.translation: 使用接受Criteria查询作为参数的match操作来过滤中间结果。

items.source: Note that we derive the name of the input collection from the ZipInfo class passed as first parameter to the newAggregation method.
items.translation: 请注意，输入集合的名称是从作为newAggregation方法第一个参数传递的ZipInfo类中派生的。

items.translation: 请注意，输入集合的名称是从作为newAggregation方法第一个参数传递的Product类中派生的。

items.source: Note: The additional parameters passed to the addExpression method can be referenced with indexer expressions according to their position. In this example, we reference the first parameter of the parameters array with [0]. When the SpEL expression is transformed into a MongoDB aggregation framework expression, external parameter expressions are replaced with their respective values.

items.source: In this introductory example, we want to aggregate a list of tags to get the occurrence count of a particular tag from a MongoDB collection (called tags) sorted by the occurrence count in descending order. This example demonstrates the usage of grouping, sorting, projections (selection), and unwinding (result splitting).
items.translation: 在本入门示例中，我们要聚合一个标签列表，以获取来自 MongoDB 集合（称为 tags）中特定标签的出现次数，并按出现次数降序排序。本示例展示了分组、排序、投影（选择）以及展开（结果拆分）的使用方法。

items.source: Use the sort operation to sort the resulting list of tags by their occurrence count in descending order.
items.translation: 使用 `sort` 操作按出现次数降序对生成的标签列表进行排序。

items.source: This example is based on the Largest and Smallest Cities by State example from the MongoDB Aggregation Framework documentation. We added additional sorting to produce stable results with different MongoDB versions. Here we want to return the smallest and largest cities by population for each state by using the aggregation framework. This example demonstrates grouping, sorting, and projections (selection).

items.source: This example is based on the States with Populations Over 10 Million example from the MongoDB Aggregation Framework documentation. We added additional sorting to produce stable results with different MongoDB versions. Here we want to return all states with a population greater than 10 million, using the aggregation framework. This example demonstrates grouping, sorting, and matching (filtering).
items.translation: 本示例基于 MongoDB 聚合框架文档中的人口超过 1000 万的国家示例。我们添加了额外的排序操作，以确保在不同版本的 MongoDB 中产生稳定的结果。本例旨在使用聚合框架返回所有人口超过 1000 万的国家，并演示了分组、排序和匹配（过滤）操作。

items.source: Sort the intermediate result by the id-reference of the previous group operation in addition to the "totalPop" field in ascending order.
items.translation: 按前一组操作的 id-reference 以及"totalPop"字段对中间结果进行升序排序。

items.source: As of Version 3.4, MongoDB supports faceted classification by using the Aggregation Framework. A faceted classification uses semantic categories (either general or subject-specific) that are combined to create the full classification entry. Documents flowing through the aggregation pipeline are classified into buckets. A multi-faceted classification enables various aggregations on the same set of input documents, without needing to retrieve the input documents multiple times.
items.translation: 从版本 3.4 开始，MongoDB 支持使用聚合框架进行分面分类。分面分类采用语义类别（可以是通用类别或特定主题类别）并将其组合以创建完整的分类条目。流经聚合管道的文档会被分类到相应的桶中。多分面分类允许对同一组输入文档执行各种聚合操作，而无需多次检索这些输入文档。

items.source: Multiple aggregation pipelines can be used to create multi-faceted aggregations that characterize data across multiple dimensions (or facets) within a single aggregation stage. Multi-faceted aggregations provide multiple filters and categorizations to guide data browsing and analysis. A common implementation of faceting is how many online retailers provide ways to narrow down search results by applying filters on product price, manufacturer, size, and other factors.
items.translation: 可以使用多个聚合管道来创建多面聚合，从而在单个聚合阶段内对数据按多个维度（或方面）进行特征描述。多面聚合提供了多种过滤器和分类方式，以指导数据浏览和分析。一种常见的方面实现方式是，许多在线零售商允许用户通过应用产品价格、制造商、尺寸及其他因素的过滤器来缩小搜索结果范围。
